Modify the GET handler so the response is { rows, total } where total is the count of fuel records matching the current filters (before LIMIT/OFFSET), and keep the rows field as the existing list. The UI calls getFuelRecords() from src/services/fuel.service.js — make sure it still works and passes pagination through.
